Who'll win the Golden Boot?
The Golden Boot is awarded to the player with the most goals during the tournament. Should there be a shared boot at the end of the tournament, you'll score 5 points for any of the players sharing the boot.
column5:
Who'll win the Golden Ball?
The Golden Ball is awarded to the player voted as the best player of the tournament.
column6:
Who'll win the Golden Glove?
The Golden Glove is awarded to the player voted as the best goalkeeper of the tournament.
column7:
Who'll win the Best Young Player award?
The Best Young Player award is awarded to a player who is under 21 at the start of the calendar year.
column16:
Which team will win the FIFA Fair Play Trophy?
The FIFA Fair Play Trophy is given to the team with the best record of fair play.
column17:
Which team will win the Most Entertaining Team award?
As voted for by a public opinion poll run by FIFA.
